behaviorChanges: new `tautline decision-record` verb -- structured, machine-local decision-ledger entries on the existing per-lane event log; works on disabled-narration lanes; carries a top-level `record_kind` = tautline-decision/v1 discriminator so readers never mistake a decision-named event for a ledger entry; no gate, guard, or review behavior changed

requiredMigrations.command: gh auth refresh --hostname github.com -s read:project -s project
requiredMigrations.description: Carried forward from 0.10.3 for lanes updating across it: grant the gh token the GitHub Projects scopes the fail-closed board gates need. Machines already on 0.10.3+ or whose token carries read:project and project need no action.

rollbackNotes: Repinning below this release removes the `decision-record` verb; recorded decision events remain inert JSONL lines on the per-lane event log, readable by any text tool. No state migration required.
